body:
Fair enough! Split this into two commits:
- Removing pytest from the repo with the in-house equivalent
- Modernizing the shader generators, demonstrating the hook functionality

Splitting the commits like this makes it much more obvious what each part is doing. If you look at the first commit, you'll notice that the new outputs are simply *renames*; it's just using the expected `.gen.h` suffix. That alone could theoretically function as a PR, but I wanted to also showcase how changing the build scripts would activate corrections via the pre-commit hook. Looking at just the second commit, the actual *resulting* changes are suddenly quite trivial; the generators are a more modernized implementation of what already existed, making an easier jumping-off point for future changes. As build scripts become decoupled from SCons, more tests can be created for the generators in isolation.
